g.text: Fig. 1. Training and test data, V3.1 (basis of the V4 figure set) versus V5. (a) Contrasts and studies in the default tables; V5 keeps all yield-
definition tiers as features and uses the 2024-2026 TEST freeze with the same selection rules. (b) Source-verified corrections (size fractions summed
into total yield with SD not summed; measurement year bound per row for study 717; green-fruit fraction excluded; stress classes BIOTIC/COMBINED
corrected; study 112 salinity flagged as disputed). (c) Independent studies per harmonised stress class. (d) Share of studies reporting each
descriptor; unknown values stay missing (e.g. hybrid status UNSPECIFIED, never 0). [V5 (2026-11-20)]
